ORDINANCE CREATING A BUSINESS AND OCCUPATION TAX FOR THE UNINCORPORATED AREAS OF TREUTLEN COUNTY, GEORGIA

WHEREAS, Article [X, 4 Paragraph 1(b) of the Georgia Constitution provides that counties may levy and collect business and occupational taxes in the unincorporated areas of the county; and

WHEREAS, prior to the date of this Ordinance, Treutlen County has not imposed such a tax; and

WHEREAS, the Board of Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia has determined that it will be in the best interests of the County to impose such a tax and to issue a business license to any and all businesses located in Treutlen County, Georgia paying such tax.

NOW THEREFORE, it is resolved and ordained that the following is adopted as an Ordinance of Treutlen County, Georgia.

1.

All businesses located in the unincorporated areas of Treutlen County, Georgia shall pay an annual business or occupation tax in the amount of $25.00.

2.

The above-referenced tax must be paid on or before 5:00 p.m, July 1, 2024, at the office of the Commissioners of Treutlen County, Georgia. Thereafter, said tax shall be paid on or before 5:00 p-m. January 1* of each and every successive year by every business located in the unincorporated areas of Treutlen County, Georgia. Penalties shall not be assessed for 30 days after the due date, but no penalties shall be assessed until the calendar year 2025.

3.

Upon the receipt of such tax, Treutlen County, Georgia shall issue each business paying such tax a business license. The license shall bear a number. The authority to designate a number for each such license is hereby delegated to the County Clerk of Treutlen County, Georgia.

4.

The business and occupation tax referenced in this Ordinance shall in no way conflict with or repeal the obligation to pay any other local, state or federally imposed tax, regardless of the nature of such tax.

5.

In the event a business located in the unincorporated areas of Treutlen County, Georgia should fail to pay the tax imposed by this Ordinance, the Code Enforcement Officer of Treutlen County, Georgia shall be authorized to issue a citation to each such business owner for each such day said business owner is in violation of this Ordinance.

6.

The penalty for violating this Ordinance shall be $25.00 or 1 (one) day in jail, with each day the business owner is in violation of this Ordinance constituting a separate violation. This Ordinance shall be enforced in accordance with the State law.

7.

All ordinances or parts of ordinances that conflict with this ordinance are hereby repealed. The sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, and phrases of this ordinance are severable. Should any section, paragraph, sentence, clause, or phrase of this ordinance be rendered invalid by a court of law, the remaining sections, paragraphs, sentences, clauses, or phrases shall not be affected, but shall continue in effect until amended or repealed by action of the governing authority of Treutlen County, Georgia.

- 8. This ordinance shall go in effect on March 2{ , 2024.
